implementation.targetScope: 148 CSS named colors; package lookup and JSON/CJS/ESM entries

changes: Color values reconstructed from normative CSS Color Level 3 data, plus the CSS Color Level 4 rebeccapurple value; no upstream runtime or table was copied.
Includes the standard cyan and magenta aliases missing from css-color-keywords 1.0.0. Context-dependent transparent/currentColor and system colors are not fixed RGB named colors.
Zero dependencies; values retain lowercase six-digit hex and conventional object lookup semantics.

caller.scope: css-to-react-native 3.2.0 beneath styled-components 6.1.17 in VentiMath. Unchanged converter acceptance uses synthetic border/text-shadow/box-shadow declarations; no app dependency switch.

dataSource.note: Only normative color-name/RGB facts are used. CSS4 adds rebeccapurple (#663399).
